# Adobe Experience Platform Tags Documentation
> Documentation for Adobe Experience Platform Tags (formerly Adobe DTM), covering implementation, extensions, APIs, and event forwarding.

Adobe Experience Platform Tags is Adobe’s tag management system for deploying and managing analytics, marketing, and advertising technologies. The documentation spans client-side tags, server-side event forwarding, extension development, and the Reactor API.

## Getting Started
- [Tags overview](https://experienceleague.adobe.com/en/docs/experience-platform/tags/home): Introduction to Adobe Experience Platform Tags and its core concepts.
- [Quick start](https://experienceleague.adobe.com/en/docs/experience-platform/tags/get-started/quick-start): Set up a property, install the library, and publish changes.
- [Companies and properties](https://experienceleague.adobe.com/en/docs/experience-platform/tags/ui/companies-and-properties): Understand organizations, companies, and properties in the Tags interface.
- [Publishing overview](https://experienceleague.adobe.com/en/docs/experience-platform/tags/ui/publishing/overview): Learn the publishing workflow, environments, libraries, and approvals.
- [Data collection overview](https://experienceleague.adobe.com/en/docs/experience-platform/collection/home): Overview of Adobe Experience Platform Data Collection capabilities.

## Tags UI and Configuration
- [Properties](https://experienceleague.adobe.com/en/docs/experience-platform/tags/ui/properties): Create and manage web and mobile properties.
- [Environments](https://experienceleague.adobe.com/en/docs/experience-platform/tags/ui/publishing/environments): Configure development, staging, and production environments.
- [Libraries](https://experienceleague.adobe.com/en/docs/experience-platform/tags/ui/publishing/libraries): Build and manage libraries for publishing changes.
- [Rules](https://experienceleague.adobe.com/en/docs/experience-platform/tags/ui/rules): Define event-driven logic using events, conditions, and actions.
- [Data elements](https://experienceleague.adobe.com/en/docs/experience-platform/tags/ui/data-elements): Store and reuse values across rules and extensions.
- [Extensions](https://experienceleague.adobe.com/en/docs/experience-platform/tags/ui/extensions): Install and configure extensions in a property.

## Publishing and Environments
- [Publishing flow](https://experienceleague.adobe.com/en/docs/experience-platform/tags/ui/publishing/overview): End-to-end workflow for submitting, approving, and publishing libraries.
- [Create a library](https://experienceleague.adobe.com/en/docs/experience-platform/tags/ui/publishing/libraries): Add resources to a library and move it through environments.
- [Manage environments](https://experienceleague.adobe.com/en/docs/experience-platform/tags/ui/publishing/environments): Create host-backed environments for deployment targets.
- [Hosts](https://experienceleague.adobe.com/en/docs/experience-platform/tags/ui/publishing/hosts): Configure Akamai, SFTP, or self-hosted library delivery.
- [Approvals](https://experienceleague.adobe.com/en/docs/experience-platform/tags/ui/publishing/approval): Understand approval requirements in the publishing process.

## Event Forwarding
- [Event forwarding overview](https://experienceleague.adobe.com/en/docs/experience-platform/tags/event-forwarding/overview): Introduction to server-side event forwarding in Adobe Experience Platform.
- [Create an event forwarding property](https://experienceleague.adobe.com/en/docs/experience-platform/tags/event-forwarding/getting-started): Set up a server-side property and basic forwarding workflow.
- [Event forwarding rules](https://experienceleague.adobe.com/en/docs/experience-platform/tags/event-forwarding/rules): Configure rules for processing and routing incoming events.
- [Event forwarding data elements](https://experienceleague.adobe.com/en/docs/experience-platform/tags/event-forwarding/data-elements): Use data elements to transform and reference event payload values.
- [Event forwarding extensions](https://experienceleague.adobe.com/en/docs/experience-platform/tags/event-forwarding/extensions): Install and manage extensions for server-side destinations.

## Extension Development
- [Extension development overview](https://experienceleague.adobe.com/en/docs/experience-platform/tags/extension-dev/overview): Build custom extensions for Tags and event forwarding properties.
- [Getting started with extension development](https://experienceleague.adobe.com/en/docs/experience-platform/tags/extension-dev/getting-started): Set up tooling and create a new extension project.
- [Extension manifest](https://experienceleague.adobe.com/en/docs/experience-platform/tags/extension-dev/manifest): Define extension metadata, views, and components.
- [Web extensions](https://experienceleague.adobe.com/en/docs/experience-platform/tags/extension-dev/web/overview): Create extensions for browser-based Tags properties.
- [Edge extensions](https://experienceleague.adobe.com/en/docs/experience-platform/tags/extension-dev/edge/overview): Build extensions for event forwarding and edge execution.
- [Submit an extension](https://experienceleague.adobe.com/en/docs/experience-platform/tags/extension-dev/submit): Package and submit an extension for Adobe review.

## Reactor API
- [Reactor API overview](https://experienceleague.adobe.com/en/docs/experience-platform/tags/api/overview): Overview of the API for managing Tags resources programmatically.
- [API getting started](https://experienceleague.adobe.com/en/docs/experience-platform/tags/api/getting-started): Authentication, headers, and basic request requirements.
- [Properties endpoint](https://experienceleague.adobe.com/en/docs/experience-platform/tags/api/endpoints/properties): Manage properties through the Reactor API.
- [Rules endpoint](https://experienceleague.adobe.com/en/docs/experience-platform/tags/api/endpoints/rules): Create and update rules using API resources.
- [Data elements endpoint](https://experienceleague.adobe.com/en/docs/experience-platform/tags/api/endpoints/data-elements): Work with reusable data values in properties.
- [Extensions endpoint](https://experienceleague.adobe.com/en/docs/experience-platform/tags/api/endpoints/extensions): Install and configure property extensions via API.
- [Libraries endpoint](https://experienceleague.adobe.com/en/docs/experience-platform/tags/api/endpoints/libraries): Automate publishing workflows and library management.
- [Environments endpoint](https://experienceleague.adobe.com/en/docs/experience-platform/tags/api/endpoints/environments): Manage deployment environments programmatically.

## Privacy, Consent, and Governance
- [Privacy overview](https://experienceleague.adobe.com/en/docs/experience-platform/tags/ui/privacy): Privacy-related capabilities and considerations in Tags implementations.
- [Consent extension guidance](https://experienceleague.adobe.com/en/docs/experience-platform/tags/extensions/client/core/overview): Core extension capabilities commonly used for consent-aware implementations.
- [Data governance overview](https://experienceleague.adobe.com/en/docs/experience-platform/data-governance/home): Understand governance controls across Adobe Experience Platform.
- [Identity overview](https://experienceleague.adobe.com/en/docs/experience-platform/identity/home): Learn how identities are handled across platform data collection.

## Web SDK and Related Implementations
- [Adobe Experience Platform Web SDK overview](https://experienceleague.adobe.com/en/docs/experience-platform/web-sdk/home): Unified client-side SDK for Adobe Experience Cloud data collection.
- [Install the Web SDK extension](https://experienceleague.adobe.com/en/docs/experience-platform/tags/extensions/client/web-sdk/overview): Configure the Web SDK through Adobe Experience Platform Tags.
- [Web SDK configuration](https://experienceleague.adobe.com/en/docs/experience-platform/web-sdk/commands/configure/overview): Configure the SDK instance and connection settings.
- [Send event](https://experienceleague.adobe.com/en/docs/experience-platform/web-sdk/commands/sendevent/overview): Send experience events from the browser to Adobe services.
- [Identity for Web SDK](https://experienceleague.adobe.com/en/docs/experience-platform/web-sdk/identity/overview): Manage visitor identity and consent with the Web SDK.

- [Known issues and limitations](https://experienceleague.adobe.com/en/docs/experience-platform/tags/known-issues): Current product limitations and implementation caveats.
- [Experience League documentation home](https://experienceleague.adobe.com/en/docs/experience-platform): Entry point for Adobe Experience Platform product documentation.
- [Adobe Developer documentation](https://developer.adobe.com/experience-platform-apis/): Developer resources for Adobe Experience Platform APIs and tooling.
